_comment: Minimal config: sets the trigger mode to AUTO (self-trigger / free-run) and the horizontal mode to AUTO (so the horizontal_scale argument sets s/div directly and always sticks), and leaves every other scope setting untouched at its current state. Pair it with the horizontal_scale argument of configure_scope() to set just the window width, e.g. configure_scope(alias, "triggerModeAuto", "1", horizontal_scale=0.001). Use it when the scope's vertical/coupling/etc. are already set the way you want and you only need it to keep acquiring. NOTE: because vertical scale, coupling, termination and trigger level are left at whatever the scope currently is, this is NOT a repeatable/traceable setup - use a full config for a validated test.
name: triggerModeAuto
